proposals.before: When Zhuangzong moved on Liu Shouguang, Siyuan and Li Sizhao took thirty thousand men out by Flying Fox, settled the country north of the passes, and seized Wu, Ji, and Ru.
proposals.after: When Zhuangzong moved on Liu Shouguang, Siyuan and Li Sizhao took thirty thousand men out by Flying Fox, settled the country north of the passes, and seized Wu, Gui, and Ru.
proposals.reason: Chinese 媯州 is Gui; rendering it as Ji confuses it with an unrelated Ji prefecture.

proposals.before: Zhuangzong attacked Liu Shouguang. Siyuan and Li Sizhao led thirty thousand men separately out through Flying Fox, pacified the lands beyond the passes, and took Wu, Ji, and Ru prefectures.
proposals.after: Zhuangzong attacked Liu Shouguang. Siyuan and Li Sizhao led thirty thousand men separately out through Flying Fox, pacified the lands beyond the passes, and took Wu, Gui, and Ru prefectures.
proposals.reason: Chinese 媯 should be Gui, not Ji.

proposals.before: He seized the cup and drained it, brandished his weapon, charged into their White Horse troops, and came back with two deputy commanders in his grasp.
proposals.after: Siyuan seized the cup and drained it, brandished his weapon, charged into their White Horse troops, and came back with two deputy commanders in his grasp.
proposals.reason: Silent subject after Zhuangzong’s speech is Siyuan; naming him removes ambiguity with Zhuangzong.

proposals.before: Wang Yanzhang hammered Yan. Zhuangzong marched out in full force. Siyuan led the van and hit Liang.
proposals.after: Wang Yanzhang hammered Yan Prefecture. Zhuangzong marched out in full force. Siyuan led the van and hit Liang.
proposals.reason: Chinese 鄆州 is Yan Prefecture; bare Yan is ambiguous with the Yan polity.

proposals.before: That month Zhang Juhun left office.
proposals.after: That month Zhang Juhan left office.
proposals.reason: Chinese 張居翰 is Zhang Juhan; Juhun is a misspelling of the standard romanization.

proposals.before: On guihai Feng Dao, Bright Hall academician and vice minister of war, and Cui Xie, grand master of splendid happiness, became vice directors of the Department of State Affairs and co-grand councilors.
proposals.after: On guihai Feng Dao, Bright Hall academician and vice minister of war, and Cui Xie, chamberlain for ceremonials, became vice directors of the Department of State Affairs and co-grand councilors.
proposals.reason: 太常卿 is Chamberlain for Ceremonials, not grand master of splendid happiness.

proposals.before: On jiazi of the seventh month Fang Ye of the west, prefect of Sui, seized Kui, Zhong, and Wan.
proposals.after: On jiazi of the seventh month Xifang Ye, prefect of Sui, seized Kui, Zhong, and Wan.
proposals.reason: 西方鄴 is the compound surname Xifang with given name Ye, not Fang Ye of the west.

proposals.before: On yiyou envoys arrived from Zangge and from Kunming.
proposals.after: On yiyou the Zangge envoy Song Chaohua and Kunming envoys arrived.
proposals.reason: Chinese names the Zangge envoy 宋朝化; the English omits his name.

proposals.before: On bingchen prisoners in the capital were amnestied.
proposals.after: On bingshen prisoners in the capital were amnestied.
proposals.reason: Chinese 丙申 is bingshen, not bingchen (丙辰).

proposals.before: In the tenth month of winter Li Jingzhou, military governor of Jingnan, marched against him.
proposals.after: In the tenth month of winter Li Jingzhou, military governor of Jingnan Circuit (靜難), marched against him.
proposals.reason: 靜難軍 is Jingnan/Jingnan-Circuit (Bining), easily confused with Jingnan 荊南; clarifying avoids polity mix-up.

proposals.before: On wushen Wang Chuanji, a Haizhou officer, killed the prefect Chen Xuan, had thrown in with Wu, and now came over in surrender.
proposals.after: On wushen Wang Chuanji, a Haizhou officer, killed the prefect Chen Xuan, rebelled by joining Wu, and then came over in surrender.
proposals.reason: Chinese 叛於吳來降 means he rebelled to Wu then surrendered to Tang; the English tense ‘had thrown in’ is awkward and obscures sequence.

proposals.before: The Tatar leader Ge led his people in submission.
proposals.after: The Tatar leader Xiege led his people in submission.
proposals.reason: Chinese 頡哥 is Xiege; truncating to Ge loses the surname syllable.

proposals.before: In the third year, spring, on gengzi of the first month, the Khitan envoy Zhuaiyu came.
proposals.after: In the third year, spring, on gengzi of the first month, the Khitan envoy Zhuaigu came.
proposals.reason: Chinese 拽骨 is better Zhuaigu/Yeegu; Zhuaiyu mismatches 骨.

proposals.before: Congrong’s revolt, the deaths of Ren Yuan and An Chonghui—these were precisely superiors and subordinates shielding one another, and praise and blame twisting what was true.
proposals.after: Congrong’s revolt, the deaths of Ren Huan and An Chonghui—these were precisely superiors and subordinates shielding one another, and praise and blame twisting what was true.
proposals.reason: Chinese 任圜 is Ren Huan; Ren Yuan is a wrong romanization.

decisions.reason: 媯州 is Gui Prefecture. Ji is a misreading of the place name.
The literal field repeats the same incorrect reading of 媯 as Ji.
The continuing subject is Siyuan, who has just volunteered to charge the White Horse troops; naming him removes a real ambiguity after Zhuangzong's speech.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 嗣源笑曰…莊宗大喜曰…因引鍾飲釂

decisions.after: Wang Yanzhang hammered Yun Prefecture. Zhuangzong marched out in full force. Siyuan led the van and hit Liang.
decisions.reason: The proposal correctly expands the prefecture name but preserves the existing misreading. 鄆 is Yun, not Yan.
張居翰 is Zhang Juhan; Juhun is a romanization error.
太常卿 is the Chamberlain for Ceremonials. 'Grand master of splendid happiness' is not this office.
西方 is the compound surname Xifang in the attested personal name Xifang Ye, not a directional modifier.

decisions.after: On yiyou, Song Chaohua, envoy from Zangge, arrived together with envoys from Kunming.
decisions.reason: The source explicitly names Song Chaohua as Zangge's envoy. The revision restores the omitted name with clearer English syntax.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 牂牁使宋朝化及昆明使者來

decisions.reason: 丙申 is bingshen. Bingchen would be 丙辰.

decisions.after: In the tenth month of winter, Li Jingzhou, military governor of Jingnan Circuit, the former Binning Circuit, marched against him.
decisions.reason: 靜難軍 is the northern Jingnan Circuit, renamed from Binning, not the southern Jingnan polity written 荊南. The revision disambiguates it without inserting Chinese into the English prose.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 靜難軍節度使李敬周討之

decisions.after: On wushen, Wang Chuanji, an officer of Hai Prefecture, killed its prefect Chen Xuan, rebelled against Wu, and came over in surrender.
decisions.reason: 叛於吳來降 says that Wang Chuanji rebelled against Wu and then surrendered to Later Tang. The proposal reverses his relationship to Wu.

sourceWitness.citation: Xin Wudai Shi 6; Jiaqing Haizhou Gazetteer parallel
sourceWitness.excerpt: 海州將王傳極殺其刺史陳宣，叛于吳來降

decisions.reason: 頡哥 represents the full name Xiege. Rendering only the final syllable as Ge truncates the name.
The extracted pinyin Zhuàigǔ confirms that 拽骨 should be represented as Zhuaigu, not Zhuaiyu.
任圜 is Ren Huan. Ren Yuan is a romanization error repeated in both translation fields and the extracted name claim.

claimRevisions.reason: Correct the romanization of 張居翰.
Restore both syllables of 頡哥.
Correct the second syllable from yu to gu.
Correct the reading of 圜 to Huan in Ren Huan's name.
